title: Coastr
description: Build your own theme park! Lay paths, place rides and food stalls, and design roller coasters piece by piece with lift hills, steep drops, loops, corkscrews, wide banked turns and launches. Build a log flume with splashing drops and a little steam railway that carries guests across your park. Hire handymen, mechanics and entertainers, take on challenges for rewards, and watch your park light up at night. Play four parks on very different maps (meadow, lagoon, desert and snowy mountain), earn stars and research new rides, or build freely in the sandbox, alone or together with friends.
description_de: Bau deinen eigenen Freizeitpark! Leg Wege an, stell Attraktionen und Essensstände auf und entwirf Achterbahnen Stück für Stück mit Lifthügeln, steilen Abfahrten, Loopings, Schrauben, weiten Steilkurven und Katapultstarts. Bau eine Wildwasserbahn mit spritzenden Abfahrten und eine kleine Dampfeisenbahn, die Gäste durch deinen Park fährt. Stell Reinigungskräfte, Mechaniker und Maskottchen ein, löse Aufgaben für Belohnungen und sieh zu, wie dein Park nachts leuchtet. Spiel vier Parks auf ganz verschiedenen Karten (Wiese, Lagune, Wüste und Schneeberg), verdiene Sterne und erforsche neue Attraktionen, oder bau frei drauflos, allein oder zusammen mit Freunden.
controls: Mouse: drag to move the map, scroll to zoom, click to build, drag to build a line of path or a whole area. Touch: drag to move, pinch to zoom, tap to build, then drag from the white dot to draw a line. Coasters: tap the arrows on the map, or use the arrow keys; tap a piece of track to change it. R turns a ride, Ctrl+Z takes back the last thing built, Esc cancels, Space pauses.
update_title: Coastr 3.0: water rides, a railway, staff and challenges
notes: New log flume: boats in a water trough, pulled up by lifts and sent down drops with a big splash
New park railway: a little steam train that carries guests between as many platforms as you build
New hyper coaster with giant hills, an on-ride photo spot for any coaster, and two new ready-made designs
Five new rides (Flying Planes, Mini Golf, Fun House, 4D Cinema, Meteor), three new stalls and twelve new kinds of scenery
Staff: guests now drop litter and rides break down now and then, so hire handymen, mechanics and entertainers and put up litter bins. Parks you already have get the staff they need
Challenges: optional tasks with a time limit and a reward, with their own high-score list
Photo mode: hide all the buttons, switch between day and night and save a picture of your park
Share a park as a code that friends can load into their own game
Goals, the park map, staff and challenges are now tabs of one panel
Two new park events, three new yearly awards and six new achievements
